Elizabeth Garst and her farm are at the forefront of the fight to educate farmers and the public on the necessity of cover crops and soil health. Elizabeth’s ancestors turned Dust Bowl land into a thriving farm with morals, and she’s not stopping there.

programme.title: The Last Letter
programme.desc: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake.

programme.title: Monster's Ball
programme.desc: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband.

programme.title: Set Up
programme.desc: With help from a gangster, a betrayed man (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) seeks revenge for a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: Falcon Rising
programme.desc: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise.

programme.title: The Pirates of Somalia
programme.desc: In 2008, rookie Canadian journalist Jay Bahadur's impulsive plan to embed himself among the pirates of Somalia provides the first close-up look at whom these men are, how they live, and the forces that drive them.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Black Cobra
programme.desc: A man is forced to smuggle and sell illegal black diamonds to pay for his father's pardon back home in South Africa.

programme.title: Iron Eagle on the Attack
programme.desc: Retired from the Air Force, Chappy Sinclair (Lou Gossett Jr.) now runs a private flight school that happens to cater to misfits and juvenile offenders. Desperate to instill discipline, Chappy hires as an instructor his former protégé, Doug Masters (Jason Cadieux), who had previously been shot down by the Soviets. During training, Doug and the youths encounter drug dealers, toxic chemicals and an insidious conspiracy that threatens to ignite a global war.

programme.title: Love and a Bullet
programme.desc: Treach of Naughty by Nature stars in this action-packed drama as Malik Bishop, a tough-as-nails gangster kid turned elite hit man. While staking out his next assignment - the innocent girlfriend of his notorious boss - Malik reflects on the dark path he's chosen but cannot escape. Torn between his sense of duty and his newfound sense of humanity, he finds that the only way out is a perilous showdown with men who are every bit as cold-blooded as he is.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: The Forgiven
programme.desc: During his life sentence in post-apartheid South Africa, brutal murderer Piet Blomfield seeks redemption through meetings with Archbishop Desmond Tutu.

programme.title: The Wash
programme.desc: The Wash is an action-comedy starring Snoop Dogg and Dr. Dre. As mismatched roommates working at a car wash, they come together to rescue their boss (George Wallace) from a couple of first-time kidnappers. If they don't settle their differences and get Mr. Washington back, the good times at The Wash will soon come to an end.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Palmira, Carranza, se instruye a los niños de las escuelas sobre la labor que el general Cárdenas realizó en México.

programme.title: Dos valientes
programme.desc: Martín, un pistolero, es asesinado, pero antes de morir pide que le oculten su identidad a su hijo. Este corre peligro cuando asiste a su funeral.

programme.title: Sucedió en México
programme.desc: Una mujer que planeaba suicidarse cambia de opinión y decide vivir e iniciar una nueva vida.

programme.title: El hombre del puente
programme.desc: La odisea del expresidiario de un país dictatorial que queda inmovilizado por falta de papeles en un puente fronterizo.

programme.title: El extensionista
programme.desc: Un ingeniero va a enseñar a los campesinos a mejorar sus cultivos y descubre la gran opresión del cacique del pueblo.

programme.title: Espejismo de la Ciudad
programme.desc: Una familia campesina vende todas sus posesiones y se muda a la ciudad, donde encuentran grandes dificultades y dolor.

programme.title: El último túnel
programme.desc: Un ingeniero que participa en la construcción de una monumental línea de ferrocarril se enamora de una hermosa tarahumara.

programme.title: Fotógrafo de Modelos
programme.desc: Un fotógrafo recibe herencia millonaria de su abuela a condición de que se purifique de vicios y mujeres por un año.

programme.title: Las movidas del Mofles
programme.desc: Un mecánico borracho choca el auto de un diputado y termina en la cárcel, así que sus compañeros cooperan para sacarlo.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: Sexo y crimen
programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up around goats, who loved to play and run, but also produced the most delicious milk which would then be used to make ricotta. Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has shared her love for gnocchi and passing on traditions for years, and in this episode she makes the gnocchi out of cheese.The comforting meal includes: Lentil Country Salad, Cheese Gnocchi with Butter and Sage Sauce, and Pork Pockets Stuffed with Pickles and Cheese.
programme.sub-title: Gnocchi Time Memories with the Grandkids

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their seasons, and they know how to make delicious soups, salads and pastas with fall and winter vegetables. programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Skillet shrimp with asparagus features sauteed shrimp over grilled bread; skillet gratinate of pork, aubergine and zucchini; one-pot soft polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia creates the ultimate heartwarming dinner table filled with dishes that deliver flavor, comfort and love in every bite. She starts with a soothing Rice and Lentil Soup topped with cheese and olive oil; Roasted Olives with Orange and Rosemary are an exciting accompaniment to any meal and Ricotta Meatloaf, a family favorite packed with cheese and topped with fresh tomato sauce and even more cheese, is the star of the show.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: From jumping the broom to tying the knot, wedding celebrations in America are as diverse as the nation itself, and Lidia cordially invites viewers to be her "plus one" on this cross-country matrimonial odyssey.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Weddings: Something Borrowed, Something New

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: If there were another name for Lidia's family, it would be the gnocchi family. They love making them together AND eating them. Lidia starts with a Butternut Squash Gnocchi that is as soft as a feather and served with a velvety sage and butter sauce. Next, she prepares a Marinated Bread of Chicken Seared with Shiitake Mushrooms, Rosemary and Sage. Her sautéed earthy Brussels Sprouts are made with pepperoncino, garlic and walnuts. They are nutty AND spicy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Tomatoes are known in the Italian culture although the tradition goes way beyond the simple tomato sauce. Lidia gathers some of her favorite tomato based recipes and shares them in this episode including: Tomato and Mint Salad, Tomato and Ricotta Crostini, Spaghetti with Quick Pantry Sauce. She finishes with a Gluttonous Tomato- a perfect appetizer or lunch dish starring oven baked tomatoes stuffed with bread, grated cheese and seasoning and topped with farm eggs. Yum!
programme.sub-title: The Versatile Tomato and All things Italian

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Panzanella with fennel and shrimp; orange and tropea onion salad; green salad with apples and provolone; cabbage salad with speck.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The key to a delicious meal is coaxing a lot of flavor from an ingredient, whether it is meat or vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares two ragu recipes: Lamb and Pepper Ragu: and a Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu: a heart, flavorful medley of chestnuts and mushrooms that make for a satisfying vegetarian ragu.

programme.title: Eating In With Lidia
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shares the stories behind the great pantry-inspired recipes that her family has been eating for years--in both good times and challenging ones.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia remembers some of her fondest childhood recipes that were made by her Grandmother Rosa in Italy. Recipes include Mussels Triestina and Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto. A fun and fruity Fruit Smash Soda is shared with her mother, Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: In the middle of Colombia, lies an ancient, unique and little explored outcrop of sandstone; the Serrania de la Macarena. It forms part of the country's first ever national park - made up of lush jungle, shrubland and savannah, isolated peaks, winding rivers and spectacular waterfalls - where more than 15 million specimens were collected during early studies of the area. Called the 'treasure of the world', scientists believe it is a hugely important bank of biological diversity.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Ocean Adventurer
programme.desc: David and his team strive to make marine biologist Erica's dream of swimming with humpback whales come true.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

programme.title: Hidden UK

programme.title: Hidden Australia

programme.title: Hidden Spain

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: Destination Wild - India's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Where the South Pacific Ocean meets the Tasman Sea, thirteen islands stretch across the blue desert as if a giant has tossed rocks from the sky above, Manawatāwhi/ The Three Kings Islands. Ancient, wild, and remote, this ocean junction bewitches many who visit. Upwellings of cold nutrient rich water support a spectacle of marine life, while a small pod of Bottlenose Dolphins has given up their nomadic ways to make this place their home.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage has a rather unique resident who is renowned as nature's lumberjack and North Americas largest rodent, the beaver. With their powerful teeth the trees they fell can be huge and their dams can be so enormous they can be seen from space. But since humans arrived here, many beavers have been forced to live in an urban jungle! And as the Wild City of Anchorage expands, that means more people, more cars, and the biggest risk to the beavers, dogs!

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to a huge number of wild porcupines, living in the city's parks, gardens and streets. Almost twice the average size, Anchorage's porcupines search for food here in the city, and find refuge during the bitter Alaskan winters. But life on the streets also takes its toll.Porcupines are the city's number one roadkill. In the wild, few animals other than wolves attempt to kill porcupines, and in the city, domesticated dogs can be as big a threat to the porcupines as wild wolves.

programme.title: Nature's Oddballs - Creatures of the Night
programme.desc: hile we sleep comfortably in our beds, one of the most spectacular groups of animals go to work - prepare to meet the creatures of the night!

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Lions, Chimpanzees, Turtles, Roe Deer, Gannets Reproduction is not only a concern of the young and restless: this episode of Aging in the Wild brings a light-hearted look at the issue of sexuality and camaraderie in older animals. We illustrate, for example, the link between the age of an elephant and its reproductive success. What are the reproductive benefits of these animals as they grow older?

programme.title: These Birds Are Made For Walking
programme.desc: Few things are more wondrous than the gift of flight, but some birds have chosen to give it up - the question is, why? Whether it's to save energy, tap into new food resources or invest in other skills, they all have their reasons. But one thing's for sure: it doesn't make flightless birds any less weird and wonderful. There are 60 species of bird that have given up the gift of flight, but they are not all related. Each have taken their own evolutionary path.

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving - but though always on the move they're not exactly speedy.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: In Anchorage, one bird rules the roost...the Bald Eagle. Expert hunters, they are perfectly adapted to life in tough arctic conditions, but in Anchorage, the secret to their survival... is trash. Every day, hundreds of bald eagles gather at the city dump, dodging trucks, machinery, and even pyrotechnics, in search of an easy meal. But this city life also brings constant danger, for the eagles themselves, and also for the human residents.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Snow Leopard is the one of the most elusive big cats in the world. This episode details how the wildlife guards and the wildlife department has set up conservation and scientific plans to protect and indeed to enumerate and increase it's population. For the first time we see the radio collaring operations of the big cats and also the very rare Lynx. The episode also shows how the guards live and work in these tough terrains sometimes even by putting their lives in danger.

programme.title: Icy Coast
programme.desc: Cold coasts create challenging landscapes for all wildlife. It's hard to believe that these freezing oceans can be bringers of life. In fact, cold water holds onto oxygen much better than warm, encouraging aquatic activity. Great eagles hunt abundant marine life in the bleak northern hemisphere whilst cold water corals thrive off the nutrient rich currents passing through their reefs, and massive elephant seals fight for territory off the coast of Australia.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: In the middle of Colombia, lies an ancient, unique and little explored outcrop of sandstone; the Serrania de la Macarena. It forms part of the country's first ever national park - made up of lush jungle, shrubland and savannah, isolated peaks, winding rivers and spectacular waterfalls - where more than 15 million specimens were collected during early studies of the area. Called the 'treasure of the world', scientists believe it is a hugely important bank of biological diversity.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In nature, competition for territory is so extreme that some animals have resorted to living in incredible hostile conditions. From brutal cold, to extreme heat, from the ocean depths, to the driest of deserts, this episode showcases some incredible survival stories in the world's most inhospitable environments.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: On the doorstep of one of the country's biggest cities, Muaūpoko /Otago Peninsula provides a breeding refuge for birds and marine mammals. Northern royal albatrosses return here every year to raise their chicks at the world's only mainland colony. On sheltered beaches around the Peninsula, once hunted from these shores, New Zealand sea lions are returning to form a breeding colony after an absence of centuries.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: Join us as we delve into the inner workings of the Two Oceans Aquarium and meet the team who keep the machine running! Learn how they cater for hundreds of different dietary requirements, how they keep up with the demand of life-giving water and meet the new arrivals to the aquarium; from the six-legged spider crabs of Japan, to the tiny turtles in need of rehabilitation. We'll move behind the glass to reveal the secrets of Africa's premier Aquarium!

programme.title: Elephants - Changing Lives
programme.desc: Living for over half a century, elephants see the world change around them as they grow. They say an elephant never forgets; if we could enter the massive brain of a veteran elephant, what would we see? Imagine one elephant to represent them all, giving us a unique glimpse into the remarkable life of these magnificent giants.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Bighorn Sheep, Elk, Male Elephants, Marmots, Baboons, Rhinos Observing two massive elk clashing their antlers is to witness a true demonstration of power. For other species, such as the European marmot, remaining in power is a matter of collaborating with family and community. Are these animals forced to give up their hard-won social status as they age? Through this lens, we take a deep and entertaining look at the challenges faced by those in power ... and what it takes to stay there.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying just off the coast of west Scotland, the Hebrides archipelago is made up of more than 500 islands and islets. Isolation from the mainland has made it the perfect breeding ground for millions of creatures, making it home to some of the largest gatherings, and greatest spectacles on the planet.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Eclipse
programme.desc: Danger once again surrounds Bella, as a string of mysterious killings terrorizes Seattle and a malicious vampire continues her infernal quest for revenge. Amid the tumult, Bella must choose between her love for Edward and her friendship with Jacob, knowing that her decision may ignite the long-simmering feud between vampire and werewolf.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 1
programme.desc: At last, Bella and Edward are getting married. When Jacob finds out that Bella wants to spend her honeymoon as a human, he is horrified, for Edward's passion could accidentally kill her. Bella does indeed survive her honeymoon, but a new complication arises when she discovers that she's pregnant, and the child is growing at an alarming rate. The pregnancy sets the wolves against Bella and Edward, but Jacob vows to protect his friend.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 2
programme.desc: Bella awakes, as a vampire, from her life-threatening labor, and her newborn daughter, Renesmee, proves to be very special indeed. While Bella adjusts to her new state of being, Renesmee experiences accelerated growth. When the Volturi learn of the baby's existence, they declare her to be an abomination and sentence the Cullens to death. Bella, Edward and the rest of the clan seek help from allies around the world to protect their family.

programme.title: Twilight
programme.desc: High-school student Bella Swan, always a bit of a misfit, doesn't expect life to change much when she moves from sunny Arizona to rainy Washington state. Then she meets Edward Cullen, a handsome but mysterious teen whose eyes seem to peer directly into her soul. Edward is a vampire whose family does not drink human blood, and Bella, far from being frightened, enters into a dangerous romance with her immortal soulmate.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: New Moon
programme.desc: After the abrupt departure of Edward, her vampire love, Bella finds comfort in her deepening friendship with Jacob Black. However, Bella's loyalties are put to the test as she becomes drawn into the world of werewolves, ancient enemies of vampires.

This results in an ongoing battle with the villainous and powerful Gen. Katana (Michael Ironside), but MacLeod receives help when the noble Juan Ramirez (Sean Connery) returns.

Suddenly caught in a clash between the supernatural and the human, Hellboy soon becomes hell-bent on stopping Nimue without triggering the end of the world.

programme.title: City of Lies
programme.desc: Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies.

programme.title: Knox Goes Away
programme.desc: Diagnosed with a rapidly evolving form of dementia, a contract killer gets the chance to redeem himself by saving the life of his estranged son.

programme.title: Killing Them Softly
programme.desc: When rival crook Johnny Amato (Vincent Curatola) hatches a plan to rob a card game run by mob lackey Markie (Ray Liotta), he picks a low-rent thug named Frankie (Scoot McNairy) to do the job. Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible.

programme.title: The Lincoln Lawyer
programme.desc: Mick Haller (Matthew McConaughey) is a charismatic defense attorney who does business out of his Lincoln Continental sedan. Mick spends most of his time defending petty crooks and other bottom-feeders, so it comes as quite a surprise when he lands the case of a lifetime: defending a Beverly Hills playboy (Ryan Phillippe) who is accused of attempted murder. However, what Mick initially thinks is an open-and-shut case with a big monetary reward develops into something more sinister.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.

programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: The Werewolf of London
programme.desc: While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami, who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: When plans for a weekend vacation hit a dead end, friends find themselves stranded in unfamiliar territory, pursued by a bloodthirsty predator. Holed up in an isolated cabin, the friends must fight to survive as the body count rises.

programme.title: The Atticus Institute
programme.desc: In the early 1970s, Dr. Henry West creates an institute to find people with supernatural abilities. When Judith Winstead comes to the facility, she exhibits amazing abilities that the military wants to turn into a weapon.

programme.title: Beneath
programme.desc: Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

programme.title: The Birds II: Land's End
programme.desc: Killer birds infest a seaside town where parents (Brad Johnson, Chelsea Field) take their children for vacation.

programme.title: The Black Castle
programme.desc: An Englishman (Richard Greene) enters an Austrian nobleman's (Stephen McNally) castle, complete with torture chamber and alligator moat.

programme.title: Blood Creek
programme.desc: Two brothers become entangled in a sinister Nazi's occult experiment at an American farmhouse.

programme.title: Captive Wild Woman
programme.desc: A mad doctor (John Carradine) turns an animal trainer's (Milburn Stone) ape into Paula the ape-woman (Acquanetta).

programme.title: Cherry Falls
programme.desc: A small-town sheriff, Brent Marken (Michael Biehn), discovers the presence of a serial killer in his sleepy hamlet. Since the perpetrator has been targeting only virgins, both male and female, the deaths cause panic in much of the local high school population. Sheriff Marken's daughter, Jody (Brittany Murphy), is among the potential victims, since she has yet to sleep with her boyfriend, Kenny Ascott (Gabriel Mann). Can the lawman stop the killer before he goes after Jody?

programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: Cucuy: The Boogeyman
programme.desc: A teenage girl under house arrest discovers that the nightmarish urban legend of the Mexican boogeyman, El Cucuy, is true.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: An all-female crew, on a boat in the middle of nowhere, must deal with an invader on their ship.

programme.title: Dead Man's Eyes
programme.desc: Blinded by acid thanks to his jealous model, an artist (Lon Chaney) needs eye tissue for an operation.

programme.title: Delirium
programme.desc: A man inherits a haunted house after spending time in a mental institution.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A mysterious masked killer terrorizes members of a family at a secluded estate.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Games
programme.desc: Wealthy and bored, Paul (James Caan) and Jennifer Montgomery (Katharine Ross) while away their hours in a New York City apartment filled with pinball machines and other amusements. The couple's routine is upended when door-to-door saleswoman Lisa Schindler (Simone Signoret) drops by and is suddenly taken ill. The Montgomerys let her spend the night. And soon, the sophisticated Lisa and her hosts embark on a new set of very adult -- and very dangerous -- games.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to California to investigate two locations at the top of their Most Haunted list. The first stop is the Winchester Mystery House in San Jose where Dave and Donna's inexperience in the tech department starts to annoy Steve. Jason and Grant debunk cold spots. They don't capture any evidence of paranormal activity. At the Queen Mary in Long Beach, the team seems overwhelmed by the size of the ship. Jason, Grant and Steve are able to debunk some of the ghostly activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Arkansas to investigate a haunted hotel. Dustin discovers that Grant's computer bag has mysteriously moved on its own. Jason and Grant capture an apparition, "the holy grail", on their thermal camera. The team is welcomed into a medium's home, the most haunted house in the town. Dustin and Dave check out the spooky hollow down the road but don't find anything paranormal. Grant captures some unusual activity on the thermal cam while recording the medium reading Jason.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Kentucky to investigate one of the most haunted places in the country, Waverly Hills Sanatorium. During the decades the facility served as a tuberculosis hospital, where an estimated 63,000 people died within its walls. Over two nights of extensive investigation, the members of TAPS have a variety of inexplicable encounters and eerie personal experiences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to searches Holliston, Massachusetts to help a family that has a spirit haunting their home. Loud footsteps are frequently heard up and down the staircase, an apparition has appeared in the master bedroom, and a voice has been heard yelling "mommy". Their young daughter is so terrified that she refuses to step foot in the basement and does not feel comfortable anywhere in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS answers an urgent call from a homeowner in Clinton, Massachusetts, who is being plagued by a disturbing spirit. Aided by Mike Dion, a member of the New England Paranormal Group, TAPS explores the home and immediately feels an uncomfortable presence throughout. Events escalate until Grant is knocked to his knees. Donna is visibly horrified by Grant's experience, but pushes on with the investigation to find out what other surprises the night may hold.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A frightened family in Glen Gardner, New Jersey calls TAPS for assistance from a menacing shadowy figure that is haunting their home. Hilary and Sean Hodgman have regularly witnessed mysterious black apparitions moving across their master bedroom. Through their investigation, TAPS encounters a series of bizarre sensations and encounters in the home. The team even captures an audio recording of a voice which is heard saying "we are coming.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Florida to investigate the paranormal activities at the historical St. Augustine Lighthouse. Armed with some new equipment, the TAPS team investigates the numerous accounts of inexplicable voices, noises and apparitions that have been reported for decades. Steve must confront his fear of heights in order to investigate the towering lighthouse, which is one of the tallest in the country. Immediately after setting up, TAPS begins to experience all sorts of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Roselle Park, New Jersey to investigate an Italian restaurant that is being plagued by a deceased former owner. Current employees believe such incidents as stools being knockedover can be attributed to a former owner, Eda, who died decades earlier in the building. The TAPS team sets out to prove whether or not Eda still lingers on the premises.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Stanley Hotel, the location that inspired Stephen King's classic novel "The Shining", is the setting for this TAPS investigation. The team travels to Estes Park, Colorado to explore The Stanley Hotel and discover what truth lies behind the fiction of the famous thriller. During the tour, TAPS is presented with stories of apparition sightings, noises of a large party coming from an empty ballroom, and even a horrifying case of apparent possession.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The season begins with the TAPS members traveling to Tombstone, Arizona to investigate the wild spirits of the old west. The group heads to the historic Birdcage Theatre, which in addition to housing performances, also served as a dancehall, saloon and casino after it opened in 1881.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Vermont, a terrified family calls upon TAPS for assistance with startling paranormal events that are taking place in their home. Since they began renovating, the Johnsons have repeatedly seen so-called "shadow people" moving through their house. One night while sleeping, Sean Johnson, the patriarch of the home, was attacked by forces that cannot be seen.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Massachusetts, TAPS explores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity. The historic home recently underwent a stage of renovation which seems to have stirred up an abundance of paranormal phenomena. The homeowners have seen a number of apparitions dressed in period clothing throughout the mansion. Mysterious voices and strange noises have also been a common occurrence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this special episode, TAPS presents investigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the unprecedented live broadcast from The Stanley Hotel in Estes Park, Colorado. Nearly 30 years ago, Stephen King's strange encounters during his stay at the establishment prompted him to write the classic horror novel "The Shining". During their intense investigation, TAPS experiences an incredible amount of paranormal activity in the rooms, halls and in the underbelly of the notorious hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruins in Ireland. These ancient ruins of a grand yet cursed estate are reportedly home to "fairies", troll-like spirits that live underground and wreak havoc on those who trespass. During an intense investigation, the team sets out to learn the truth behind the legends. What was already an unusual investigation turns to panic as TAPS realize they are being hunted by something from the beyond.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this terrifying episode, TAPS investigates The Hellfire Caves, an elaborate maze of underground caves in rural England. The caves served as the center for a secret satanic society hundreds of years ago. Politicians and other influential people of the era used the deep caves to escape persecution and keep their religious practices shrouded in the utmost secrecy. Today, the eerie history of the caves has manifested into numerous accounts of startling paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A local homeowner in need of emergency assistance visits the TAPS office after a series of bizarre incidents threaten the tranquility of her home. Lynn Tedeschi has the sense that something mysterious, and possibly dangerous, is present in her home. Her children are terrified by toys which inexplicably turn on and off. Strange sounds move through the home as if echoing from the distant past. TAPS spends the night to determine if a haunted house is lurking in their own backyard.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to the aid of a family in Chesapeake, Virginia terrified by the arrival of paranormal activity in their home. Ever since the Keffers began remodeling, they have been plagued by bizarre events. These include the unexplained movement of antique dolls and the sighting of apparitions dressed in period clothing. The Keffers' situation is compounded because they are members of the Mennonite religious community.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to Hollywood for a pair of unforgettable investigations. The first stop for the team is the site of one of the most horrifying crimes in American history. In 1969, five people were brutally murdered by members of the Charles Manson religious cult, including actress Sharon Tate and her unborn child. A homeowner who now lives 200 feet from the site of those crimes is convinced the victims haunt his Hollywood Hills home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS is in the Pacific Northwest to investigate former insane asylum, the Northern State Hospital. Jason and Grant meet the skeptical caretaker, who wishes to dispel the stories of ghostly activity, but when the team is confronted with strange sounds and shocking evidence, they are left to determine whether or not there might be a little truth to the local tales. Then TAPS heads to Seattle's Underground Tunnels, a subterranean labyrinth below the city streets.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS investigates the historic Presidio in San Francisco. Both employees and members of the military have reported ghostly encounters at this former military fortress. Strange tapping noises, phantom footsteps and sightings of a ghostly female apparition in Spanish attire are just a few of the chilling stories. The TAPS team is left to wonder if there are former soldiers still walking the halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever TAPS comes to the aid of a priest whose home is a source of unexplained activity. Both Reverend Jennings and her parishioners have heard footsteps in the hall ways, the sounds of crying children and have seen objects moving by themselves. An unusual mark scorched into her bedroom floor baffles the team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to the infamous town of Salem, MA for a pair of baffling cases to uncover what vengeful spirits might still roam this site of centuries-old witch trials and executions. The Lyceum Restaurant was formerly the home of Bridget Bishop, the first woman in Salem executed for suspected witchcraft. Witnesses report frequently seeing the apparition of a woman dressed in period clothing.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. They will talk about their favorite investigations and delve into some hot button issues - like Steve's biggest fears. Then the team takes time to answer important questions from viewers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: An urgent call from Dave Tango's father sets the scene for the next case. William Tango, an ex-cop and amateur ghost hunter, was baffled by unexplainable events he experienced on a recent trip to the Burlington County Prison in Mt. Holly, New Jersey. The TAPS team soon discovers William is not alone. Once the site of numerous executions, the prison maintains an unmistakable feeling of dread.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the past nine years unexplainable sounds at the Clapp Library have put Jacques, the night custodian, on edge. The unmistakable sound of books sliding off of shelves and dark shadows moving through the stacks are just some of the eerie events plaguing the library. Desperate to prove to other employees that he's not going crazy, Jacque calls in TAPS to find some answers. During the investigation Jason and Grant hear a strange sound coming from the balcony area.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, when overwhelming reports of paranormal activity plague the Wright - Patterson Air Force Base, TAPS gets enlisted to help the military. For the past ten years, the air force base has been host to strange experiences. Recent renovations at the base have resulted in escalating activity. At the Arnold House, personnel have reported hearing children's voices and footsteps walking up the stairs. And, in Building 70, ghostly apparitions have put everyone on edge.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS heads to the Mt. Washington Hotel in New Hampshire to be the first paranormal group to investigate this legendary resort. The expansive property sits on top of a massive limestone deposit, known to be a catalyst for paranormal activity. The caretakers here have experienced everything from doors that open and close by themselves to full body apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the abandoned Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum. Built in 1858, the asylum was able to accommodate over two thousand patients ranging from deranged violent criminals to the children of the clinically insane. The chilling reports of unexplained sounds, shadowy figures and violent attacks are thought to be the result of restless and tortured spirits still roaming the halls.

After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles.

programme.title: Unlikely Angel
programme.desc: A dead country singer (Dolly Parton) seeks to get into heaven by uniting a troubled family during the holidays.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Fatal Instinct
programme.desc: Ned Ravine (Armand Assante) is a police officer and lawyer who occasionally defends the delinquents he arrests. He crosses paths with a seductive femme fatale, Lola Cain (Sean Young), during an assignment and promptly begins an affair with her. Meanwhile, Ned's wife, Lana (Kate Nelligan), is deep in an affair of her own. Lana and her lover, Frank (Christopher McDonald), are planning to murder Ned in an elaborate fashion so they can collect on his triple indemnity life insurance policy.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: Angela de Marco (Michelle Pfeiffer) is fed up with her gangster husband's (Alec Baldwin) line of work and wants no part of the crime world. When her husband is killed for having an affair with the mistress of mob boss Tony "The Tiger" Russo (Dean Stockwell), Angela and her son depart for New York City to make a fresh start. Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent (Matthew Modine) looking to use her to bust Tony.

programme.title: Burnt
programme.desc: Adam Jones, former chef at one of Paris' premier restaurants, wants to turn his life around. After destroying his career with drug use and a manic drive for perfection, he is given another chance to fulfil his dreams of gaining three Michelin Stars. Returning to London, he assembles a crew to create one of the finest restaurants ever and gain the recognition he has always wanted in the culinary world, but the journey is certainly not an easy one.

programme.title: Make It Happen
programme.desc: Embarking on a journey to fulfil her dreams as a dancer, a young girl discovers a new style of dance that proves to be the source of both conflict and self-discovery.

programme.title: My Week With Marilyn
programme.desc: In 1956 England, Colin Clark (Eddie Redmayne) lands a job as a production assistant on the set of "The Prince and the Showgirl," starring Marilyn Monroe (Michelle Williams). Marilyn is also honeymooning with her new husband, playwright Arthur Miller, but the combined pressure of work and the demands of the Hollywood hangers-on is driving her to exhaustion. When Miller departs for Paris, Colin seizes the opportunity, to give Marilyn respite during a week in the idyllic British countryside.

programme.desc: Three of the most acclaimed actors of their generations in a human comedy for today. In this family, change is relative.

programme.title: Noronha Spinners
programme.desc: This is the story of the most charismatic inhabitant of the most beautiful island of Brazil: the spinner dolphins from Fernando de Noronha. Famous for their acrobatics, in which spinners may rise more than 3 metres above the water and spin up to 7 times around their bodies, the dolphins are true ocean wanderers. They live in tropical open waters around the world, and some may spend years without ever seeing land. But a population of these dolphins, the Noronha Spinners, behaves very differently.

programme.desc: Valerie Alston (Joanne Whalley-Kilmer) is placed on the jury for the criminal case of mob boss Rusty Pirone (Armand Assante), and it's not long before she is threatened by Pirone's right-hand man, Tom Vesey (William Hurt). Though it is clear to the 11 other members of the jury that Pirone is guilty, Valerie must convince them to find him innocent. If she doesn't, her son will be killed. Valerie is only following Vesey's orders out of fear, but her conscience begins to haunt her.

Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Prison on Fire
programme.desc: Yiu (Tony Leung Ka Fai) is a young advertising executive in Hong Kong. One night, defending his father from attack, he accidentally shoves a street thug in front of a bus. Sentenced to three years in prison, Yiu is "fresh meat" for the hardened criminals and triad stooges that run things, and is preyed upon by sadistic guard Scarface (Roy Cheung). The virtuous Ching (Chow Yun-Fat) intervenes, teaching him the ropes of prison life, and a tender friendship develops between the two.

programme.title: Police Story

programme.title: The Dark Crystal

He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: The Air I Breathe
programme.desc: Four stories are linked by a Chinese proverb and overlapping characters. A usually unadventurous man (Forest Whitaker) loses big on a horse race and robs a bank to pay off a gangster (Andy Garcia). The gangster's nephew goes on the town with a hit man (Brendan Fraser) who can see into the future. The hit man falls for a pop star (Sarah Michelle Gellar) whose contract is owned by the gangster. The pop star has a rare blood type sought by a doctor (Kevin Bacon) trying to save the love of his life.

programme.title: Silent House

Long vacant, the house has no utilities, forcing the trio to rely on battery-operated lanterns to light their way. Sarah becomes separated from her relatives and soon finds she is trapped inside the cabin, with no contact with the outside world. Panic turns to real terror as the young woman experiences events that become increasingly ominous.

programme.title: Valentine: The Dark Avenger

Unfortunately, she couldn't pick a more undeserving guy when she starts a relationship with womanizer Chad (Jeremy Sisto). programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: America's orchards and farms balance hand labor with mechanization through efficient harvesting methods; explore orchard management, California's largest fruit packing house, Nebraska corn fields, Wisconsin cranberry marshes, and more.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Around the world and across the eons, gold stands as a symbol of power, wealth, and love; the story of the hunters of the precious metal and their methods for extracting it.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: A fascinating journey from farm to table; the dizzying heights of California's date palm trees; the soggy Wisconsin cranberry marshes; the cavernous labyrinths of Pennsylvania's mushroom farms; picking through the unique forms of harvesting.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Digging up salt mining's history, from the "white gold" on the table to the oceanic and underground deposits whence it came; today people take salt for granted, but most life depends on it.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Dynamite explodes hills, drills divide stone walls, and giant cranes pull 400,000-pound blocks from quarry pits; rock serves as civilization's raw material for roads, buildings, paint, glue, makeup, antacids, and chewing gum.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: From Stonehenge to the Hubble Telescope, mankind has always been a race of stargazers; unforgettable film footage and expert accounts reveal the facts of astronomy's most mind-boggling discoveries.
programme.sub-title: Observatories: Stonehenge to the Space Telescopes

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Star City, the Gagarin Center for Training Cosmonauts, was established by the former Soviet Union in the 1960s as a school for the future conquerors of space.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The history of long-duration life in space from the first Soviet station to Skylab to Mir to the International Space Station; what it is like to live in space, as well as the monumental obstacles engineers and astronauts overcame to make it possible.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Every process, from beginning to end, is a unique and incredible adventure; from the fiery birth of high-tech golf clubs to the cataclysmic end of old buildings, get ready to race from start to finish.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Adrenaline runs high when Adam Richman visits the factory where Yamaha makes ATVs, WaveRunners and more; an inside look at a company built to get people sky-high in paramotors; amusement park Diggerland USA; mech-suits; submarine built for two.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Blade implements have been a part of civilized man's arsenal since the Paleolithic Age, when sharp tools were chipped off of flint or obsidian; but with the discovery of metallurgy, people were able to forge stronger, more versatile blade implements.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The Wilson Sporting Goods football factory; Rawlings' Costa Rica baseball factory; the National Soccer Hall of Fame; the National Baseball Hall of Fame.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Every aspect of live involves pressure; it's what puts the bubbles in soft drinks, propels shaving cream from its can, cools the contents of your refrigerator, and causes volcanoes to erupt; but rapid pressure changes can be as violent as explosions.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: For centuries, banks enable the creation of wealth; a chronicle of banking, from its early European origins to e-banking; modern technology revolutionizes the way banks do business.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Mixtures of metals and caustic chemicals that make our tech, tools and toys surge with energy; visit the world's most powerful battery in Fairbanks, Alaska--13,760 hulking cells humming with 5,000 volts, ready to help the city survive power outages.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The biggest machines and their smallest counterparts; Airbus A380 and microjet; Boss Hoss 425-horsepower bike and 18-inch tall pocket bike; world's smallest production car.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: All it takes to set off a booby trap is an unsuspecting victim lifting, moving, or disturbing a harmless-looking object; the history of booby traps from the ancient Egyptians, Chinese, Greek, and Romans to the Middle Eastern crisis.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: A journey around the U.S. to legendary tailgating colleges like Penn State, the University of Miami, and a visit to the home-team parking lots of the Packers, Cowboys, and Eagles; the evolution of tailgating from horse and buggy to tricked-out RV.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Testing the breaking points of vehicles and crash test dummies; firing rounds at bulletproof glass; breaching a safe; the breaking points of steel and concrete.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Targeting the historical trajectory of bullets, ranging from their origins in the 1300s as stones and lead balls to the "safe" and "smart" bullets of today.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Trains capable of speeds of up to 190 miles per hour can be found throughout the world; scientists are looking at new alternatives to electricity, including magnetic levitation that can move passenger trains 345 miles per hour and beyond.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Examining how frequently experts in various disciplines can hit their targets, including archers, sharpshooters and even a billiards player; the ancient world's ballista and trebuchet weapons; knife thrower; Cirque du Soleil's daring artists.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Defensive fortifications span WWI bunkers to futuristic structures; explore submarine bunkers at Lorient housing 20 subs, Churchill's Cabinet War Room, Hitler's Berlin bunker, Cold War shelters, and nuclear weapon protection bunkers.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The history of photography began as early as the eleventh century; the advancements by Niépce and Daguerre in the 19th century and William Henry Fox Talbot and George Eastman in the 19th and 20th centuries.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: More than two million people die in the U.S. annually, creating 5,500 daily burials with 80 percent choosing caskets and 20 percent cremation; explore dealing with death throughout centuries and today's $20-billion funeral industry.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Some toys transform into valuable collectibles and become iconic classics; Adam sees how Play-Doh is created, visits the mecca of pinball manufacturing, learns how Slinkys keep springing back, and gets an inside look at Lionel trains.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Tiny weapons may not sound impressive, but small can kill, and it can also be easily concealed; from a pocket pistol used by the police to a submachine gun wielded by a bodyguard, many of today's most effective weapons are smaller than ever.

programme.desc: Quirt Evans (John Wayne), a cowboy on the run, is injured when his horse stumbles near a Quaker family's land. The family takes him in as he regains his health, and he falls for their young daughter, Penelope (Gail Russell). As Quirt falls deeper in love and becomes accustomed to the family's peaceful ways, his violent past starts to catch up to him. Eventually he is forced to decide whether it is worth letting go of his turbulent former life for his future with Penelope.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. programme.title: Rookie Robot
