programme.desc: The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake; when they learn that a magical love artifact is behind the thefts, they enlist help from Vikram's old friend, Cupid himself.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Wars in the Middle East Collection
programme.desc: Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait resulted in more than one million troops facing off against each other in the desert of the Persian Gulf. The Allied Coalition's air war, known as Operation Desert Storm, involved the most sophisticated technological weaponry available.
programme.sub-title: Modern Warfare: The Persian Gulf War - Part 2

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: As the last Nazi offensive of the war develops, the vicious SS Panzer divisions leading the attack resort to murder, a dangerous fifth column slips into the American camp causing chaos and confusion, and the desperate defence of a key Belgian town seems doomed.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Sergeant Cleo Lehenbauer, nicknamed 'Indestructible,' is wounded during the 101st Airborne's D-Day jump and after being hospitalized returns to Normandy. In September, he walks through a mine infested field and rescues two comrades in Holland. After conflicts with his commander in the 5th Armored Division, he transfers back to the 101st, where he helps stop the last major German offensive.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 30 January 1933, Hitler became chancellor and the Nazis quickly seized state power. Foreign diplomats in Berlin, turned into spies and whistleblowers, witnessed both Nazi infiltration of high society and the exclusion of Jews. Drawing on rare archives, this documentary reveals their warnings about the rise of National Socialism-and how the world ignored them.
programme.sub-title: Ambassadors in Berlin: The Whistleblowers of WWII

programme.title: Blood Money - Inside the Soviet Economy
programme.desc: In 1941, as Nazi Germany invaded, the USSR faced collapse. Stalin ordered entire factories moved east by train-steelworks, tank plants, munitions lines. Millions of workers became an army of labor, rebuilding industry and forging weapons far from the front.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Hitler, Göring, and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology, and even weapons of war. Far beyond affection, their fascination fueled pseudo-scientific projects and genetic manipulation. Through archives, expert insight, and re-enactments, this documentary uncovers how the Nazis exploited nature to serve their brutal vision.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches: 1944-1945
programme.desc: Through exclusive film archives and written journals, we will reveal a lesser known chapter of the end of the Third Reich, a story of brutality and murder. In the final months of World War II, 700,000 prisoners were evacuated from concentration camps and traveled throughout Europe. 250,000 to 300,000 died from exhaustion or were massacred by the guards or even civilians in Austria and Germany.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: After the swift success at Smolensk, Hitler has diverted the bulk of Heinz Guderian's panzers down to the South, so as to capture the Ukrainian capital Kiev, considered more important than Moscow in Hitler's mind. It begins a gigantic clash and turns out to be the biggest military encirclement in history.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: The war was started solely by Germany's and Japan's acts of aggression. But in 1944 they are being driven from the lands that they had conquered and are being pressured to an act of unconditional surrender.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: This final installment is review of the entire series. Highlights deal with the rise of Naziism, concluding with the burning of London; President Roosevelt's declaration of war and the first joint Allied campaign in North America; the campaign onto the European continent across Sicily to Italy; the planning and execution of the mighty invasion of the coast of France; D-Day; the Liberating of Paris.

programme.title: Visions of War: World War II - The Beginning
programme.desc: German assault troops land on river edge and advance rapidly through city streets. Bombed buildings explode as soldiers move forward along streets. Adolph Hitler in car rides through streets and is saluted by German soldiers. German soldiers rush forward, surround car and greet Hitler and high command. Goering looks over map at conference table. Animated map battle positions in Poland.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: This film explains how the people of the Republic of Vietnam attempted to build a nation amidst the holocaust of war. Parallels are drawn with our own Revolutionary War, and the years that followed in which our founding fathers built the substance and structure of a nation.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: A Nation Builds Under Fire

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: In the Warsaw ghetto, Emanuel Ringelblum and the other members of the documentary group Oyneg Shabbos collected whatever they could to recount life in the ghetto. When they learn of the death at Chelmno of Jews from neighboring towns and from the Lodz ghetto at the end of 1941, they realized that the Nazis and their local auxiliaries had embarked on an operation of annihilation.

programme.title: WWI The War To End All Wars - Part 1: The Valley of Death
programme.desc: June 1914, Europe was in the midst of an idealic summer. The nations of Europe were joined together by webs of trade and capital. Their royal houses linked by bonds of family and marriage. Global trade was at an all time high. The prospect of all an all out European war was unthinkable, pundits said. No one saw the catastrophe coming, until it came. World War I - The War to End All Wars.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The Fall of Saigon occurred on April 30, 1975 when the South Vietnamese government announced its unconditional surrender to North Vietnam. As a line of tanks smashed through the gates of the presidential palace, Vietcong troops rounded up government soldiers, and raised their red and blue flags. The United States Embassy remained under control of the U.S. Marines.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: It fell to the Russians to enter Berlin first, and as Hitler took his own life in his bunker, the war in Europe finally came to an end. Winston Churchill led the people of Britain in the VE Day celebrations, but the fighting continued in the Pacific.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With Europe sifting through the rubble of a long and bitter war, the Japanese refused to surrender. A long land campaign was too high a price to pay. Truman took the decision to end WWII swiftly, with the nuclear bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: After 18 months of preparation, the Allied Expeditionary Force launches the largest amphibious landing in history, with 160,000 troops storming the Normandy coast. Facing years of German fortifications, success hinges on overcoming immense challenges during the critical first 24 hours. Victory remains uncertain as the world watches anxiously.

programme.title: Kwai - The Death Railway
programme.desc: In 1942, Japan forced over 200,000 Asian civilians and 65,000 Western POWs to build a railway through the Thai-Burmese jungle. After 15 months, 120,000 were dead from exhaustion, hunger, and disease. Today, the bridge on the river draws tourists, while survivors recall the harrowing sacrifices and human cost behind its construction.

programme.title: The History of Tanks
programme.desc: Documenting the changing face of tank warfare over the past 100 years, this fascinating documentary is not to be missed by those with an interest in military history and weapon development.

programme.title: Guy Martin: D-Day Landing
programme.desc: To mark the 75th anniversary of D-Day, Guy Martin restores a Dakota plane, undergoes brutal training with the Red Devils parachute display team, and parachutes into the Normandy countryside.

programme.title: Einsatzgruppen: The Nazi Death Squads
programme.desc: Carnage continues from September to December 1941. After the EZG's intervention, Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary and the Baltic states are declared 'Judenfrei': free of Jews.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Yom Kippur War
programme.desc: Yom Kippur, the holiest day on the Jewish calendar. Israeli troops came under surprise attack by Syrian and Egyptian forces, ten times greater than their own. This time they learned to respect the courage and abilities of the armies, engaging in the biggest and bitterest tank battles since the second World War.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: June 22, 1941. Under the code name 'Barbarossa', Nazi Germany invaded the Soviet Union. In the first hours of the attack, bombs rained down on Soviet airfields on the frontier, opening the way for the Panzer division and definitely breaking the German-Soviet non-aggression Pact, signed two years earlier. For the Soviets, it was a complete surprise...
programme.sub-title: WWII - Operation Barbarossa - Summer: Blitzkrieg Victories

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: The men of the 283rd Medical Attachment, providing air ambulance support in Vietnam.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: Combat story of 10th armored division in World War II, with focus on events related to fighting around Metz and Bastogne. Combat story of 10th armored division continued - fighting in Bastogne and ensuing events during push to Brenner Pass from December 1944 to April 1945.

programme.title: Operation Plunder The Rhine Crossing
programme.desc: This program covers the growth of German aggression, 1934-1940. Contains many animated maps explaining German tactics and many views of Adolf Hitler making speeches and in conferences. Shows a large Nazi rally and Axis-inspired riots in Belgium and France. Also shows a Nazi rally in Madison Square Garden. Included is footage of Joachim von Ribbentrop and Fritz Kuhn.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific examines Japanese military aggression and growth prior to World War II. It looks the creation of the puppet state Manchukuo in Manchuria and the eventual war with China. It examines Japanese imperial interests in Philippines, Malaya, Singapore, and Indochina and discussions the decision to bomb Pearl Harbor.
programme.sub-title: The Rise of the Japanese Empire

programme.title: Great Battles Of The Civil War: Volume 2
programme.desc: This in depth volume combines archival material with faithfully created battle re-enactments to depict the real horror and heroism of the American Civil War combat from 1863-1865. Witness the sacrifice of over 600,000 patriots in fierce hand-to-hand combat and face-to-face warfare struggling to preserve their ways of life.

programme.title: Africa Freed
programme.desc: The conquest of Tunisia was a triumph for the United Nations, who on land, sea and air, worked as one. This film, together with another made by American Allies, shows how victory was shaped and achieved. Africa Freed tells chiefly of the part played by British arms as recorded by our cameramen who marched alongside. It is a tribute to those fighting with allies in American and France.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: June 6, 1944... Operation Overlord was a colossal undertaking. 150,000 Allied Forces landed on five beaches in Normandy, France. It was the first phase in the liberation of Western Europe. When GIs from the First U.S. Army landed, the Allies believed the Germans would withdraw to the Seine. The American Forces would then advance to Brittany, the banks of the Loire, and Paris, but they were wrong!

programme.title: Living in the Shadow of WWII
programme.desc: Total war extends the battlefields - in the Second World War, for the first time, civilian casualties far outnumbered those of military personnel. And a significant proportion of those casualties were victims of the bombing campaigns waged by both sides. What was the effect of living through 'the Blitz', what precautions were taken, what forms of shelter were constructed?

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: This episode takes you through the tense hours of the largest seaborne invasion in history: Operation Neptune, often referred to as D-Day. The operation began the liberation of France and laid the foundations of the Allied victory on the Western Front.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: By 1942, the war has reached a global scale. This episode examines key battles in North Africa, the Pacific, and the Eastern Front, as well as the escalating human cost of the conflict. The tension builds as the Axis powers push forward, threatening to overwhelm their adversaries, and the world braces for what seems like an inevitable collapse.
programme.sub-title: Part 4 - The World on the Brink

programme.title: Iron Curtain - Life Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: By Stalin's 70th birthday in 1949, Soviet domination of Eastern Europe is complete. Cities bear his name, collectivization uproots families, the Church is persecuted, and youth indoctrinated. Jews face new purges, culminating in Prague's show trials. With fear gripping 80 million people, Stalin's death in 1953 finally sparks a wave of hope for change.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia creates a seasonal meal that says 'Family Time'. Pork and grapes are a natural combination, and in today's menu she prepares Pork Medallions with Grapes; Baked Fennel with Sage and for dessert, a colorful and perfect cold weather Orange in Marsala for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Garlic and Onions appear in many Italian dishes, and in this episode they actually become the "star ingredients." Lidia starts the meal with a quick and easy Savory Onion Tart followed by a delicious, mild and creamy Garlic Risotto. For dessert, it's all about chocolate with the moist Torta Caprese.
programme.sub-title: Lidia's Kitchen - Garlic and Onion Steal the Show

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about family in this episode as Lidia shares three of her favorite family recipes. Marinated Meatballs, Zucchini Parmigiana, Artichoke Carbonara and Jam Filled Mezzaluna are the stars of this episode.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring Lidia's family to the table. In this episode, Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini, a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joining her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today features a collection of the best of Italian dolce or sweets - from cookies to cake to pudding. Lidia begins this episode with Anise Cookies, then prepares a Mint Granita, a light and heavenly Angel Cake with Fresh Berries, and lastly a Rice Pudding with a Blessing, inspired by one of the convents in Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia prepares Lentil Country Salad, Cheese Gnocchi with Butter and Sage Sauce, and Pork Pockets Stuffed with Pickles and Cheese.
programme.sub-title: Lidia's Kitchen - Gnocchi Time Memories with the Grandchildren

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta! In this episode, Lidia starts with the simplest - a Spaghettini with Olive oil and Rosemary, then moves on to a hearty dish of Tagliatelle with Meatballs and Eggplant, and finishes with a delicious whole wheat pasta- Baked Whole Wheat Penne with Ceci Beans.
programme.sub-title: Lidia's Kitchen - Trio of Heartwarming Pasta

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Brisket-a word that makes mouths water-is the heart of Texas barbecue and the base for Irish corned beef, Jewish pastrami, and Vietnamese pho. From Franklin Barbecue in Austin to NYC's Katz's Deli, experience brisket ramen blending Texas and Tokyo and Korean BBQ that grills brisket in under a minute.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Obsessed with Brisket

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: This show gives grilled and smoked vegetables their due. We start with hot stuff from India: a spectacular Tandoori Cauliflower with Coriander Mint Chutney. From the West Indies comes a squash gratin fired with habanero chiles and perfumed with wood smoke. Not to leave our carnivorous friends out, Mexican-American chef Johnny Hernandez cooks Borrego, Mexican pit-roasted lamb.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Planet Barbecue

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: The U.S. is often described as a global melting pot. We focus on three grilled dishes with international roots. Shrimp cocktail gets the East-West treatment with Thai spices and smoked jalapeños. Chipotle Ribs with chocolate and Drunken Salsa spiked with tequila and roasted chiles. Dessert sounds an equally unexpected note: a luscious Planet Barbecue "Banana" Split made with grilled plantains.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Global Melting Pot

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: In this episode, we'll travel the BBQ trail from Venezuela to Peru, starting with a Venezuelan specialty-Asopao (seafood rice), reimagined here on the grill by Caracas-born chef Geronimo Lopez. And then a twist on two Peruvian delicacies-Tuna Anticuchos (kebabs) and Smoke-Roasted Peruvian Potato Salad.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - From Caracas to Lima

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Brazilians are world masters at the art of the rotisserie. In this show, learn to cook beef, chickenand pork with the proverbial turn. We start with Brazil's celebrated Picanha (fat cap sirloin)-served with farofa and Country-Style Salsa. Next, Brazilian Pork Loin grilled with Bacon and Prunes, and finally, Rio Chicken Rollatini. So put on some samba music and get ready to rock the grill.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - The Brazilian Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue
programme.desc: Texas BBQ to many means brisket, but in this show, you'll experience the Texas Trinity: Grilled Quail with Pear Salsa and Blue Cheese Farroto prepared by San Antonio master chef Jason Dady. Smoked and Grilled Rib-Eye Steaks accompanied by Smashed Potatoes. And a sizzling sandwich, a Hot Gut Hero (beef sausage with pepper Jack cheese). It's the Texas Trinity hot off the grill.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Texas Trinity

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Ciudad Juárez, Pati joins in with a group of Pachuco dancers, who are passionately preserving this distinctive Prohibition-era culture's traditions. Together they head to the iconic Kentucky Bar, rumored to be the birthplace of the margarita. Later, she savors an icon of Juárez's food scene, the burrito, at Burritos El Compa where the Olivares are keeping their family legacy alive.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: For the indigenous Rarámuri people, long-distance running through Chihuahua's majestic Copper Canyon is a way of life. Pati meets the Moreno brothers, who are famous for winning ultramarathons. In Huetosachi, community leader María Monarca teaches Pati about the art of cooking with corn in Rarámuri cuisine, from nixtamalization to a traditional dish known as "chacales."

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Chihuahua's capital, Chihuahua City, Pati meets the first member of the Rarámuri people to become a world-famous pianist, Romeyno Gutiérrez, who teaches her the basics of Rarámuri music before taking her to his favorite barbacoa spot. Pati's also invited into the home of Chef Ana Rosa Beltrán del Río to cook a few ancient Chihuahuan recipes and learn the art of drying chiles.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - Symphony of Flavors

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati journeys to Casas Grandes to experience the preserved foods, or "conservas," that sustained people during the Mexican Revolution. She meets a family that has lived for generations at Hacienda de San Diego, Mexico's "White House" for a day after the battle of Casas Grandes, including Diana Acosta and her mother, Sara Ramírez, who still preserves food the way they did during the war.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati saddles up for an exhilarating ride into the heart of Chihuahua's ranch and rodeo life. She gets a lesson in roping and riding from rodeo champion Ricardo "Bubba" Nevárez and his friends, then is invited to a post practice carne asada. She also meets Chihuahua's most influential cattle rancher, Álvaro Bustillos, at his Rancho El Arroyo, where the ranch cook serves up some cowboy delicacies.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Casas Grandes, Pati rides in style with local art curator Mayte Luján in her 1960s Cadillac. Mayte owns a bed and breakfast, Las Guacamayas, where she invites Pati into the kitchen to make chile con queso in impossibly soft flour tortillas. Later, Pati learns about another tasty export from Chihuahua, pecans, at Gustavo Vázquez's farm, where his family has been growing them for generations.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Mata Ortiz, a village known for its exquisite pottery, and learns its history from local potter Tavo Silveira, who is known worldwide and even made a piece for the pope. Then Pati gets her hands dirty with talented duo Laura Bugarini and Héctor Gallegos, who teach her the basics of Mata Ortiz pottery. Turns out, Tavo can also cook and makes an asado de puerco feast in the town square.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Mata Ortiz

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. They begin at the local market to source ingredients. Then Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking and isn't shy to correct him. The final product is a meal that captures Yucatán's history in every bite.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Family Affair

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tekit, or "The Capital of the Guayabera," Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets Eliodoro Xicum, a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts. Then she meets his son, Elio, who chose to become a chef and created a dish that resembles a Guayabera in honor of his father.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor y Mónica hacen el amor; él no olvida a Chabela, pero quiere que lo ayude a no pensar en ella. Aurelio y Tim buscan un culpable del asesinato de Andrews, y Rivero detiene a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cristina, drogada, entra a la fuerza a casa de Víctor, donde Mónica la enfrenta. Furiosa, la periodista le dice a Rutila que se vengará. Leonor no resistiría estar de nuevo presa, y Omar le propone huir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Desesperada, Mónica le pide ayuda a Omar para huir con su hijo, luego de confesarle a doña Alba que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel. Morejón acusa a Ignacio del atentado a Monteverde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba reconoce que Aurelio es un criminal y está decidida a matarlo. Leonor se enfrenta a tiros con Mónica frente al edificio de Omar. Feyo y Casillas viajan a Cancún, dispuestos a vengarse.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio encuentra a Luzma drogada y bebiendo sin control. Ella lo culpa, le dice que consume la droga que él vende. Alba le dice a Víctor y Rutila que enviará a Carlitos a Colombia con su tía.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor acepta la propuesta de Omar de convertirse en la señora Terán. Rivero no cree que el agente de la DEA asesinó a Andrews, mientras Morán le dice a Tim que él y los Casillas lo mataron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba amenaza con un arma a Aurelio, y él le pide que lo mate de una vez. Ella no dispara y llama a Feyo para decirle que se cuide. Omar miente, le asegura a Leonor que no conoce a Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo y Aurelio llegan a Cancún listos para matar. Rutila le confiesa a Rivero que el Chema es el padre de su hijo, y le pide que lo asesine. Begoña consigue drogas en el cuarto de Luciana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le revela a Víctor que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel y sus hijos, pero él desespera y no quiere creerlo. Feyo acusa a Casillas de soplón, pero dejan su enfrentamiento para luego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor culpa a Aurelio de la muerte de Chabela y se van a los golpes: le dice a su tío que está con Mónica, que no se atreva a hacerle daño. Feyo y el Chema se asocian y van contra Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo estalla de la rabia; le tiende una trampa a Belén para que vaya a casa de Justino y, delante de Aurelio, la amenaza de muerte. Ignacio le pide ayuda a Leonor para liberar a su asistente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo degüella y manda a enterrar a Belén ante los ojos de Aurelio, y le exige que pida perdón por ensuciar a la mujer que amaba. Casillas se va con Luzma de Michoacán tras la amenaza de Aguilera.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le dice a Aurelio que no lo quiere ver más, y él les propone a ella y a Esperanza que hagan una despedida los tres. Feyo dice en su rancho que Belén no regresará y prohíbe hablar de ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Morejón tiene problemas de bebida, y su esposa y colaboradores están preocupados. Aurelio sufre un fuerte dolor por deficiencia renal. Mónica negocia con Esperanza a espaldas de Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Junto a Esperanza, Aurelio se decide por el lavado de dinero y le deja el narcotráfico a Víctor; además, no perdona a Mónica por revelar su secreto. Cristina venderá información de Casillas a Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ramiro consigue que Aurelio apoye sus planes con Omar para ponerle la mano al poder político, y le revela que Terán y Mónica son primos. Luzma se escapa con el Chef y llegan a casa de Cristina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de una noche de amor con Rutila, el Chema sale de su madriguera para ayudar a Feyo, sin imaginar los planes de Rivero. Mónica convence a Omar para que vaya a la cita con Ramiro Silva.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar está aterrado al saber que Ramiro lo escogió para ser presidente de México y que recibirá órdenes de Aurelio. El Chema escapa y hiere a Rivero, mientras Leonor rescata a Rutila y a su hijo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los estudiantes son ejecutados por orden de Feyo, quien, junto con el Chema, busca matar a los Casillas. Aurelio entrega su imperio a Mónica y Víctor. Rutila encuentra el dinero para huir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le cobra con sangre a Cristina su traición, y la mata frente a Esperanza, mientras le jura a Feyo que se vengará por lo que le hizo a Alba. Tim captura al general venezolano en Aruba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En un atentado organizado por Aurelio para levantar la candidatura de Omar, Ignacio mata a Leonor en un acto de campaña. Pasan dos años, la salud de Casillas se deteriora y reúne a su familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema y Feyo atacan a la familia Casillas y Luzma queda gravemente herida. Mónica está embarazada de Víctor, mientras él es víctima de una emboscada en Colombia, traicionado por Tijeras.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para vengarse de Feyo, Aurelio visita en la cárcel a María Sol y lo llama para que escuche cuando la ahorca. Desesperado, Aguilera advierte que matará a todos los Casillas. Javi salva a Víctor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Esperanza le ofrecen dinero a Amparo por el riñón de Carlitos, pero ella se niega. Mónica busca a Víctor y le dice a Casillas que está embarazada. Omar necesita saber quién mató a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Con ayuda del Oficial, Feyo se propone matar a Casillas y descubrir quiénes son sus aliados. Aurelio y Esperanza quieren seducir a Amparo. Omar pide a Ignacio averiguar quién le disparó a Leo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica tiene un mal presentimiento y pide a Javi que la ayude a sacar a Víctor de la selva. El Oficial se propone matar al Chema, mientras Ernestina informa a Ramiro que Aurelio está enfermo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Oficial y el Reyecito atacan con bazucas al Chema, quien jura venganza tras escapar. Furioso llama a Feyo y le dice que es el primero en su lista. Rutila llega con su hijo a casa de Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Ingeniero le dice a Torito que la era del Chema terminó, mientras Eleazar habla con Venegas para eliminar al Oficial, el Reyecito y Tijeras. Ramiro, interesado en Amparo, le ofrece trabajo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un mimo le alegra la vida a Rosa, no quiere separarse de él, pero su esposo no soporta la situación. Hace un video para humillar a su hija cuando le dispara a su laptop y le rompe el teléfono.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Teresa deja que Rubí le extraiga su menstruación con una aspiradora para acortar el ciclo, pero no imagina que esa sangre se vende por internet. Incumple un contrato por una buena causa.
programme.sub-title: Aspirando la regla; Una buena decisión

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Se lanza del carro por una rabieta y provoca una tragedia. La condenan a pagar una indemnización por la golpiza que propinó y ella le exige a su pareja que la pague porque le salvó la vida.
programme.sub-title: No fue intencional, fue accidental; La abuela karateca

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Angélica demanda a Linda por daños al salir de su spa con cuatro cejas y quemaduras. Cher acusa a Jonathan de drogar a su mascota, un lémur, que se puso agresiva y le sacó un ojo a la dueña.
programme.sub-title: Me desfiguró el rostro; Drogas en la mascota

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariana sufre del síndrome de Raynaud que provoca sensibilidad al frío en los dedos, no quiere mudarse a otra ciudad. Nancy fue secuestrada y ahora siente una conexión especial con su captor.
programme.sub-title: Dedos de hielo; Almas gemelas asesinas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Anthony fue investigado por el delito de pornografía infantil, él cree que su suegra lo incriminó. Lina tiene obsesión con casarse, pero Carlos no quiere poner en riesgo su estatus migratorio.
programme.sub-title: Difamado por venganza; La novia loca

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alejandro fue abusado de niño por un creador de videojuegos, exige compensación aunque su atacante está muerto. Cristian testifica en la corte y lo arrestan, ahora quiere recuperar a su hijo.
programme.sub-title: Abusado por mi héroe; Testigo ilegal

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Grisel quiere la custodia de su nieto porque la mamá, Gabriela, casi lo deja abandonado en el aeropuerto. Además, Edgar encuentra pepitas de oro dentro de los salmones que le vendió Rubén.
programme.sub-title: Mi nieto abandonado en el aeropuerto; Falsa fortuna

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniel buscó a su esposa por mucho tiempo y, ahora que logra encontrarla, descubre que ella está casada con otro. El marido de Alejandra conducía ebrio y por accidente mata al hijo de Willie.
programme.sub-title: El pasado oscuro; DUI mató a mi hijo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Dalila, modelo de pasarela, fue discriminada en el evento que organizó Karla, le impidieron participar por tener síndrome de Down sin tomar en cuenta su enorme talento para desfilar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lourdes está casada con José, ella le exige que acepte su discapacidad, pero él se niega porque se siente sano y fuerte. Dos niñas se enfrentan por unos "tickets" para ir a Euro Disney en París.
programme.sub-title: José, el enano; Problema de niños

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ernesto sufre las consecuencias de tener un vecino obsesionado con las armas. Además, Lily exige que un emú sea operado porque se tragó la esmeralda que estaba en su anillo de matrimonio.
programme.sub-title: Aire mortal; El emú y la esmeralda

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: George tuvo un accidente en bote con su hija y ahora la madre exige la custodia, porque el padre alcoholizado no supo cuidarla. Roni mete huevos en las paredes por venganza contra su hermana.
programme.sub-title: Peligro de mar; La venganza del huevo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hija de Karen, menor de edad, es fanática de los tatuajes, pero sufre serios daños al hacerse uno en el brazo. Melisa le inyecta a su abuelo su propia sangre porque él quiere rejuvenecer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Camilo se ha quedado casi ciego y las conexiones nerviosas entre los ojos y el cerebro le provocan unos dolores insoportables, por los cuales tiene que tomar unos analgésicos tan fuertes que le han provocado adicción. Su esposa Carolina lo abandonó y no quiere regresar si no se saca los ojos. En otro caso, Vanessa le regaló su casa a Yenni supuestamente bajo los efectos de una brujería que le invalidaba su voluntad. Ahora quiere anular esa transferencia, pero Yenni alega que la casa ya es suya.
programme.sub-title: Que se saque los ojos; Estafa embrujada

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ninoska le repara una pieza dental a Mari que antes le había dado problemas, ahora enfrenta una demanda. Le pasan la lengua a los helados y luego los devuelven, para dañarle el negocio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carolina dice que Patricia oculta un pasado que afecta la relación, ella le reprocha el haberlo destapado. Quiere el divorcio de su esposa porque siente que es un depravado sexual.
programme.sub-title: El secreto peligroso; Culpa y capricho

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Señalan a Juan de participar en el secuestro y muerte de una parte de la familia de Abel. Debby subasta el agua de unos baños que se dio y su amigo Josué le exige la mitad del dinero ganado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natalia quiere la custodia de su sobrina abusada por la pareja de su hermana. Rosa, recuperada de su enfermedad, regresa de un viaje y descubre que su hija está enamorada de su padrastro.
programme.sub-title: Maldad en la sangre; Niña loca por amor

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Martha tiene satiriasis, una enfermedad que provoca un desenfrenado deseo sexual. Milagros sufre histeria femenina y solo se calma con los masajes de su yerno, su hija está molesta.
programme.sub-title: Mi hijo tiene satiriasis; Mujeres histéricas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su marido muere por un malentendido, exige compensación. En la ceremonia del pañuelo comprueban que la novia no era virgen y se cancela la celebración, lo que provoca una deshonra a la familia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Susana le pide una compensación a Alex, quien se interpuso en una discusión de pareja y provocó la muerte de su esposo. Geidy quiere divorciarse de Roberto, y que él y su ex desalojen la casa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lorena demanda a Claudia por tenderle una trampa que pone en peligro su asilo. Amanda se enamora del hijo de su amante, y tienen un bebé juntos, pero ahora la abuela no reconoce a su nieto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrea quiere que Juan Carlos la indemnice porque fue prostituida durante un viaje en barco. Rossi desea casarse con un vestido lleno de luces, su esposo tiene fotofobia y quiere el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés estaba felizmente casado con Roberto, pero se fue de viaje y regresó transformado en mujer. Eustacio es un octogenario que le alquiló su vivienda a Mildred y ahora quiere recuperarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yennifer renta su vientre, pero tiene orden de deportación, Rey, el padre del bebé quiere que dé a luz antes de irse. El creador del "órgano-piano" desea patentarlo, pero su esposa se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María Eugenia quiere que su esposo Armando pague el rescate que piden por su hijo secuestrado, pero su esposo no está dispuesto a arriesgar el capital que tienen porque no hay garantías. Tina se hizo unas fotos con Ángel, pero este nunca se las entregó. Ahora ella descubre que las fotografías fueron utilizadas como carnada para cazar a depredadores sexuales.
programme.sub-title: La realidad de un secuestro; Caza depredadores

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Maruchka demanda a su amiga Lily por publicar un video de ella donde se muestra su sobrepeso. Julio y Martina están en desacuerdo sobre el medicamento que le recetó el pediatra a su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Lilian murió en un ataque de pánico provocado por unos alumnos de su colegio que dijeron que el ICE estaba en la escuela. Ahora Lilian demanda a Sara y Amaris, las madres de esos niños. Samuel es modelo y fue contratado por la agencia de David, quien presuntamente fue víctima de unos hackers que robaron toda la información privada de sus clientes, afectando entre todos a Samuel, quien debe más de 30 000 dólares.
programme.sub-title: Terror a la migra; Venta de información

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pedro fue golpeado por vándalos y en la cirugía dañaron su cerebro, ahora no controla sus instintos sexuales. Alexandra descubre que su inquilina tiene un negocio clandestino de placer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El interés en una herencia ha motivado a Sandra a hacer lo imposible para que Wilmer no sea el beneficiado y de esta forma mantener a su hija como heredera. Melissa quiere recuperar a su hijo, que fue adoptado por Raúl, quien, junto a su esposa, ha cuidado al niño como parte de un negocio con el padre del chico, que es un capo que está en la cárcel y pronto saldrá a buscar al niño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cleris le exige a Stephanie que le devuelva a su hijo, lo dejó con ella para alejarlo de su padre, un militar cubano. Amanda demanda a su madre por dejarla con su padrastro, él abusó de ella.
programme.sub-title: El hijo del coronel; Protector depredador

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luego de dos meses en coma, tras una pelea doméstica, ya no tiene a sus hijos y ahora los quiere de vuelta. El esposo los descubre en la cama y, en medio de la pelea, el amante lo mata y huye.
programme.sub-title: El disparo oscuro; Amor a palo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yuleika cree en la tradición latina de que los golpes enseñan y lo aplica con su hija de 20 años, incluso delante de su nieto. Isabela denuncia a su papá con la policía y lo deportan.
programme.sub-title: Quiero ser de ella; La niña detective

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gustavo es guardaespaldas y fue baleado durante el secuestro de la familia que protege. Además, Jorge descubre a Yanelis con el mecánico, ambos estaban en el garaje, desmayados y desnudos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Olga ha dedicado toda su vida al cuidado de su hija, quien nació con problemas neuronales. Por otro lado, Rosa se enamora de un chico mucho más joven que ella y decide divorciarse.
programme.sub-title: La muerte, una opción; Señora de las cinco décadas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Acusan a David de violar a Aidé, pero ella asegura que él de quien abusó fue de su hermana. Le entrega los ahorros a su marido para comprar un camión, pero él lo invierte en su otra familia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Fernando no quiere más hijos, pero su esposa se aprovecha de él mientras duerme para tener sexo. Lázaro vandaliza la empresa de Orlando porque envía suministros a la dictadura de Daniel Ortega.
programme.sub-title: Detrás de la niña; Suministro al diablo

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet brings a message for Dipsy and Laa-Laa. The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po feels like having some Tubby Custard. The Teletubbies watch some children visiting a conservatory and drawing cacti. Tinky Winky goes for a walk. Five birds appear in Teletubbyland and the Teletubbies dance round the flowers.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: All four Teletubbies pop up to say hello. The Teletubbies watch some children joining in with Debbie. Laa-Laa makes up a song, which makes the other Teletubbies run away.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Three Teletubbies dance through Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Dipsy climbs a steep hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet brings a message, which makes Po laugh. The Teletubbies watch Mark and Zoe decorate cake with butter icing, chocolate and strawberries.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: All four Teletubbies stride across Teletubbyland to say hello. The Teletubbies watch a little girl take her rabbit to the vet.
programme.sub-title: I Want to be a Vet

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet brings a message that makes Laa-Laa laugh. The Teletubbies watch some children learning about the number one. The Teletubbies take turns to wear the skirt.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little girl whose Mum has a very special job. Po has too much Tubby Custard and Tubby Custard Tummy and there's time foe one more dance before Tubby Bye-Bye.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: All four Teletubbies pop up to say hello. The Teletubbies watch some children joining in with Debbie. Laa-Laa makes up a song, which makes the other Teletubbies run away.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making bubbles. Magic things happen when Laa-Laa bounces her ball all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet brings a message for Dipsy and Laa-Laa. The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little girl whose Mum has a very special job. Po has too much Tubby Custard and Tubby Custard Tummy and there's time foe one more dance before Tubby Bye-Bye.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa has fun watering the flowers when a watering can appears. The Teletubbies watch some children making flowers. The Teletubbies make up a dance. The animals are on the march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
